facts.fact: Cabo Verde's National Elections Commission president said that until the country has a legal regulatory framework, countering AI-amplified electoral disinformation rests on inter-institutional collaboration with platforms, universities and media.

CPV.note: Article prints no date of its own; the publication date is a proxy.

facts.fact: Cabo Verde's National Elections Commission says it already uses artificial intelligence for several activities, including civic education and content creation.

CPV.note: Publication date is a proxy; the article prints no date of its own.
No AI built in the country stated.
Electoral commission is a state body, not a paper, party or group criticising a named policy; nothing on cuts or punishment.
